BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY;
SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '5s';
SET LOCAL lock_timeout = '500ms';
SET LOCAL application_name = 'ce1_ce100_readonly';
WITH session_role AS (
 SELECT rolname, rolsuper, rolcreaterole, rolcreatedb, rolcanlogin, rolbypassrls
 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = current_user
), activity AS (
 SELECT count(*) AS connections,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE backend_type='client backend') AS client_connections,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE state='active') AS active,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE wait_event_type='Lock') AS waiting_lock,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE state='idle in transaction') AS idle_in_transaction,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE state='active' AND query_start<now()-interval '30 seconds') AS active_older_30s
 FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database() AND pid<>pg_backend_pid()
), stats AS (
 SELECT numbackends,xact_commit,xact_rollback,blks_read,blks_hit,temp_files,temp_bytes,deadlocks,
 conflicts,blk_read_time,blk_write_time,stats_reset
 FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname=current_database()
), extensions AS (
 SELECT extname,extversion FROM pg_extension
 WHERE extname IN ('pg_stat_statements','pg_cron','pgmq','vector','pgstattuple')
), schemas AS (
 SELECT nspname,has_schema_privilege(current_user,oid,'USAGE') AS session_usage,
 has_schema_privilege(current_user,oid,'CREATE') AS session_create
 FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname IN ('public','comparator_internal','auth','storage')
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'captured_at',clock_timestamp(),
 'current_database',current_database(),
 'current_user',current_user,
 'session_user',session_user,
 'server_version',current_setting('server_version'),
 'read_only',current_setting('transaction_read_only'),
 'statement_timeout',current_setting('statement_timeout'),
 'lock_timeout',current_setting('lock_timeout'),
 'max_connections',current_setting('max_connections'),
 'track_io_timing',current_setting('track_io_timing'),
 'pg_in_recovery',pg_is_in_recovery(),
 'wal_level',current_setting('wal_level'),
 'archive_mode',current_setting('archive_mode'),
 'database_size_bytes',pg_database_size(current_database()),
 'session_role',(SELECT to_jsonb(r) FROM session_role r),
 'activity',(SELECT to_jsonb(a) FROM activity a),
 'database_stats',(SELECT to_jsonb(s) FROM stats s),
 'extensions',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e) ORDER BY e.extname) FROM extensions e),
 'schema_privileges',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s) ORDER BY s.nspname) FROM schemas s)
) AS evidence;
ROLLBACK;

BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY;
SET LOCAL statement_timeout='5s';
SET LOCAL lock_timeout='500ms';
SET LOCAL application_name='ce1_ce100_readonly';
WITH relations AS (
 SELECT n.nspname AS schema,c.relname AS name,c.relkind AS kind,c.relrowsecurity AS rls,
 c.relforcerowsecurity AS force_rls,pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner) AS owner,
 has_table_privilege(current_user,c.oid,'SELECT') AS session_select,
 has_table_privilege(current_user,c.oid,'UPDATE') AS session_update,
 has_table_privilege('anon',c.oid,'SELECT') AS anon_select,
 has_table_privilege('anon',c.oid,'INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE') AS anon_any_write,
 has_table_privilege('authenticated',c.oid,'SELECT') AS authenticated_select,
 has_table_privilege('authenticated',c.oid,'INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE') AS authenticated_any_write,
 has_table_privilege('service_role',c.oid,'SELECT') AS service_select,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policy p WHERE p.polrelid=c.oid) AS policy_count
 FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
 WHERE c.relkind IN ('r','p','v') AND
 ((n.nspname='public' AND c.relname IN
 ('catalog_product_embeddings','catalog_product_match_cache','catalog_product_match_cache_status',
 'catalog_location_prices','mercadona_products','carrefour_products','consum_products','plusfresc_products'))
 OR(n.nspname='comparator_internal' AND c.relname IN
 ('catalog_embedding_pipeline_control','catalog_embedding_runs','catalog_embedding_run_jobs','catalog_match_store_versions')))
), functions AS (
 SELECT n.nspname AS schema,p.proname AS name,pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS arguments,
 p.prosecdef AS security_definer,pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) AS owner,p.proconfig AS settings,
 has_function_privilege('anon',p.oid,'EXECUTE') AS anon_execute,
 has_function_privilege('authenticated',p.oid,'EXECUTE') AS authenticated_execute,
 has_function_privilege('service_role',p.oid,'EXECUTE') AS service_execute,
 md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) AS definition_md5
 FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace
 WHERE (n.nspname='public' AND p.proname IN
 ('catalog_cheaper_products_v7','catalog_cheaper_products_v6','catalog_finalize_embedding_batch','catalog_embedding_pipeline_status'))
 OR (n.nspname='comparator_internal' AND p.proname='catalog_cheaper_products_v5')
 OR (n.nspname='private' AND p.proname='claim_free_comparator_use')
), schema_roles AS (
 SELECT n.nspname AS schema,r.role,
 has_schema_privilege(r.role,n.oid,'USAGE') AS usage,
 has_schema_privilege(r.role,n.oid,'CREATE') AS create
 FROM pg_namespace n CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('anon'),('authenticated'),('service_role'))r(role)
 WHERE n.nspname IN ('public','comparator_internal','private')
), stats_extensions AS (
 SELECT e.extname,n.nspname AS schema FROM pg_extension e JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=e.extnamespace
 WHERE e.extname='pg_stat_statements'
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object('captured_at',clock_timestamp(),
 'relations',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.schema,r.name) FROM relations r),
 'functions',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(f) ORDER BY f.schema,f.name) FROM functions f),
 'schema_roles',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s) ORDER BY s.schema,s.role) FROM schema_roles s),
 'stats_extension',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s)) FROM stats_extensions s)
) AS evidence;
ROLLBACK;

interpretation_limits: Captures are separate snapshots, not one atomic read or a 15-minute sustained baseline.
q1 activity is limited to current database excluding own PID; q4 activity covers all databases excluding own PID. Connection totals are not directly comparable.
Administrative postgres has BYPASSRLS. Metadata inspection is not an end-user RLS/HTTP authorization test.
any_write is OR across INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE privileges, not proof of all three or permission to write through RLS.
Five inspected catalog tables have SELECT-only policies; broad legacy grants remain a least-privilege review item, not a demonstrated write exploit.
Schema USAGE and function EXECUTE do not by themselves establish API-exposed schemas or complete call-chain safety.
pg_stat_user_tables counts are estimates; dead tuple ratios are not measured physical bloat.
Database and statement counters are cumulative; stats_reset may be null. Rollbacks include deliberate diagnostic ROLLBACKs and are not an app error rate.
track_io_timing=off: zero recorded read/write time is not zero I/O or measured I/O latency.
archive_mode=on and archived WAL activity do not establish PITR activation, a verified backup inventory or a tested restore.
Daily Pro backup entitlement is not evidence of actual successful backups for this project.
Existing queue length was not reread. Pipeline paused and cron disabled were observed; no active synchronization or worker correctness guarantee.
Targeted relation/function lists are not a full catalog or migration audit.
Dashboard summary percentages with different windows/sources are not comparable measurements or maximum/p95 values unless documented.
Backup timestamps listed in the dashboard establish available listed restore points, not verified backup contents or a measured recovery time.
No longer blocked on dashboard authentication; actual remaining obstacle is incomplete performance evidence.
